recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Do not rewrite the General Parameters table merely to force the literal phrase 'see below' because the current links are clearer and semantically satisfy the approved issue; revisit only if FHIR-I wants a broader redesign of where _elements interaction-scope guidance lives.
issue_request: FHIR-35837 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to remove the ambiguous HTTP General Parameters sentence saying the impact of _elements was not defined for interactions other than search where a response bundle contains more than one resource type, and to add clearer _summary and _elements detail pointing readers to Search Summary and Search Elements.
initial_application: Commit 34bb8eb8fff1e9cfbb4438cac08983b4e7357999 explicitly applied FHIR-35837 to source/http.html by deleting the confusing note and adding dedicated _summary and _elements paragraphs with the requested links. The current table rows do not literally reduce all four general parameters to 'see below', but they already route readers to the relevant immediate detail or search sections and do not preserve the ambiguity raised by the issue.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes show the issue was continued on 2022-04-18 and approved 13-0-0 as Persuasive with Modification on 2022-04-25. Later source/search.html now states that _elements may be used outside search, addressing the Jira comment concern for search-page readers; that later clarification is tracked by FHIR-43354 and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-27054 separately clarified typed _elements restrictions for included Bundle entries. Zulip searches for the seed key, title, and ambiguous phrase found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/http.html no longer contains the ambiguous 'impact of _elements' sentence and includes the requested _summary/_elements descriptions; current source/search.html contains the relevant non-search and included-resource clarifications.

Published R5 _elements change clarifying typed element restrictions for included Bundle resources, which supports the nearby included-resource concern mentioned in FHIR-35837 comments.
